entries.24aea8c35a094b9c: This business develops and sells real estate and operates commercial facilities in the United States and other countries. It is carried out by subsidiaries including HASEKO America, Inc., which operates commercial facilities and is developing a new detached-house sales business on Oahu, Hawaii. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,314 million, up 24.5% from ¥3,466 million in the previous fiscal year, but this is the smallest business among the four reportable segments. Ten U.S. companies are listed as major equity-method associates, and the voting rights held in all of them are 50.0% (indirect ownership). In October 2025, HASEKO UK LIMITED was established in the United Kingdom. From the fiscal year ended March 2026, the name of this reportable segment was changed from 'Overseas Related Business' to 'Overseas Business'.

entries.8d292ffd6df3ad76: This is a business centered on the management and operation of existing housing. Haseko Kanri Holdings Co., Ltd. oversees the condominium management business, Haseko Community Co., Ltd. and others handle building management of condominiums for sale, and Haseko Livenet Co., Ltd. and others handle leasing and rental management of condominiums and other properties. Haseko Business Proxy Co., Ltd. handles management agency services for company housing, Haseko Senior Well Design Co., Ltd. operates paid nursing homes and long-term care insurance business, and Haseko Systems Co., Ltd. and others provide related services such as printing. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥158,525 million, up 9.1% from ¥145,296 million in the previous fiscal year. The number of condominium units under management was 448,076 (as of March 31, 2026, up 1.1% from the previous fiscal year-end), and the number of occupied senior service units was 2,786 (up 2.5% from the previous fiscal year-end). The company cites steady growth in new management contracts and progress in move-ins to paid nursing homes and housing for the elderly as the reasons. From the fiscal year ended March 2026, the name of this reportable segment was changed from Service-Related Business to Management and Operations Business, and the breakdown of subsidiaries making up each segment was partly changed.

entries.c210cfcafbfd693f: This business sells and leases condominiums, and also undertakes their sales on consignment, distribution brokerage and renovation. Haseko Fudosan Holdings Co., Ltd. oversees the condominium sales business, and Haseko Fudosan Co., Ltd., Sogo Jisho Co., Ltd. and Haseko Sogo Kaihatsu Co., Ltd. sell and lease condominiums. Haseko Arbest Co., Ltd. handles sales of condominiums on consignment, Haseko Real Estate Co., Ltd. handles real estate distribution brokerage and condominium renovation, and Haseko Intec Co., Ltd. handles interior sales. Haseko Fudosan, Sogo Jisho and Haseko Sogo Kaihatsu, 3 companies, place construction orders with the filing company, and Haseko Arbest sells the filing company's condominiums for sale. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥290,209 million, up 16.2% from ¥249,845 million in the previous fiscal year. The reason is an increase in new handovers of condominiums for sale, sales of income-producing properties, and the number of real estate brokerage transactions handled.

entries.da2d8b1babe87645: This is a general construction business that undertakes everything from planning and design to construction of condominiums and other buildings. The core of the business is the filing company, HASEKO Corporation, and its subsidiaries such as Fuji Kensetsu Co., Ltd., Hasek Co., Ltd. and Haseko Furnishing Co., Ltd. undertake construction contracts and sell and rent construction materials and equipment, while the filing company places orders with these affiliates for part of its operations and construction work, planning, design and supervision of condominiums and office buildings, and construction materials. Large-scale repair and interior renovation are carried out by Haseko Reform Co., Ltd., and the construction and sale of detached houses are carried out by Hosoda Komuten Co., Ltd., Haseko Home Co., Ltd., Wood Friends Co., Ltd., Forest Note Co., Ltd. and Lumber Land Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥820,088 million, up 5.3% from ¥778,746 million in the previous fiscal year, the largest of the four reportable segments. The company received orders for 64 new condominium construction projects (45 in the Tokyo metropolitan area and 19 in the Kinki and Tokai areas), of which 22 large-scale projects of 200 or more units were in the Tokyo metropolitan area and 14 were in the Kinki and Tokai areas. A total of 104 completed construction projects were finished, including 12 rental condominiums and similar buildings. For construction orders placed with the filing company on a non-consolidated basis, 91.7% were negotiated contracts (contracts in which the client designates the counterparty) and 8.3% were competitive bids, measured by contract value. The company states that its ability to gather land information, its product planning capability, its commitment to construction quality and schedules, and its efficient production system are highly regarded by project owners.
